name: Hana Nakamura
source:
Hana is affectionate, playful, and rarely shy about making herself at home around [url=/c148150]you[/url]. She brings an easy warmth to the Nakamura household, though her teasing can test [url=/c148175]Naomi[/url]'s patience. You remember protecting her from unwanted attention; getting to know her again means giving her room to speak for herself.
